coverage.summary: Applies to any tenant of residential premises. The section states no unit-count, building-age, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits.

evidence.quoted_span: Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals against any tenant of residential premises

result.notes: Coverage for G.L. c. 186, § 18 (D053) reaches 'any tenant of residential premises'. The section has no unit, age, owner-occupancy, landlord-size or preemption terms, so all of those fields stay null. The nonpayment-of-rent carve-out only limits when the presumption applies, not which buildings are covered, so it is not coverage. The exemptions in the rent-control initiative petition (DX14/DX15) and in c. 151B (D049) belong to other rules and do not apply here.
